page.title: Privacy requests
page.description: Handle written access and erasure requests (GDPR) from arquebusiers and external owners. For users, use their detail page.

lookup.title: Look up a person
lookup.description: Type the DNI/NIE in the request to see what PolvorApp holds about that person.

reference.label: Request reference
reference.help: Identify the written request you received, for example with its registry number. Do not type the person’s name or DNI/NIE: it is kept in the audit log.

summary.title: Data PolvorApp holds
summary.nothingHeld: PolvorApp holds no data about this person.

entries.title: Order entries by edition
entries.caption: The person’s order entries, by edition

export.title: Download the personal data
export.description: A ZIP with a spreadsheet of all their data and their photos is downloaded, to hand over to the person. PolvorApp keeps no copy.

erase.title: Erase {{name}}’s data?
erase.description: Their registry record goes, with their weapons and photos, and their order entries and loans are anonymised. Quantities are kept.
erase.userDescription: The account is closed for good: its name and email are erased, and the audit log will show it as “Erased user”.

warnings.title: Before you erase
warnings.listsChange: The {{year}} lists of {{comparsa}} (order {{status}}) will no longer name this person.
warnings.entryRemoved: Their entry in the {{year}} order of {{comparsa}} will be removed, because orders are open.

erase.filesPending_one: {{count}} stored file is still to be erased: it will be erased automatically.
erase.filesPending_other: {{count}} stored files are still to be erased: they will be erased automatically.

counts.auditEntriesRedacted_one: {{count}} audit entry cleared of personal data
counts.auditEntriesRedacted_other: {{count}} audit entries cleared of personal data

privacy.notFound: PolvorApp holds no data about this person.
privacy.busy: Someone else is changing this data. Try again in a few seconds.
privacy.storageUnavailable: The photos could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.
privacy.auditUnavailable: The request could not be recorded, so it was not carried out. Try again in a few minutes.
privacy.selfErasure: You cannot erase your own data. Ask another administrator.
privacy.alreadyErased: This user’s data is already erased.
privacy.lastAdmin: This is the only active administrator: invite or reactivate another administrator before erasing them.

errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Try again.

nationalId.checkLetter: The letter does not match the number.

reference.invalid: Use one line, without emails or DNI/NIE.
